test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The cost of painting the total surface area of a 30 m high solid right circular cylinder at the rate of Rs. 25 per m² is Rs. 18,425. What is the volume (in m³) of this cylinder [use π = (22)/(7)]?
solution:
**Given:**

Height of right circular cylinder = 30 m

Cost of painting = Rs. 25/ m²

Total cost of painting = Rs. 18,425

**Concept used:**

Total surface area = Total cost over Rate 

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of cylinder = 2πr(r + h) sq. unit

Volume of cylinder = πr²h cubic unit

Where, r = radius of base, and h = height of cylinder

**Calculation:**

Let, the radius of the cylinder = r 

According to the concept, 

Total surface area = 18425/25 = 737 m2

According to the question,

⇒ 2πr(r + 30) = 737

⇒ 2 × (22)/(7) × r(r + 30) = 737

⇒ (44)/(7) × r(r + 30) = 737

⇒ 44 × r(r + 30) = 737 × 7

⇒ 4 × r(r + 30) = 67 × 7

⇒ 4r² + 120r - 469 = 0

⇒ r = 7/2, - 67/2

So, r = 7/2 m [∵ Radius will be positive]

Now, the volume of the cylinder = (22)/(7) × (7/2)² × 30 = 1155 m3

**∴ The volume of the cylinder is 1155 m3**.
